evidence.mechanism: shot-08s: diagonals at midspan split into ochre and rust bars under the marker; by shot-20s a load-position by diagonal heatmap shows the sign flip as colour bands.
evidence.ambition: shot-20s: a 2D influence-line heatmap of about 40 diagonals sits under a statics-solved truss; one flat layer plus a load sweep, no depth or material, bytes well under budget.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: cream ground with thin graphite chords and clean ochre and rust diagonals; the glow halos on active bars look blotchy and the truss runs off the right edge.
evidence.distinctness: shot-20s: a heatmap of diagonal sign flips has no counterpart in the anchor set; warm cream and rust echo anchor-12 but the content is a statics plot, not an orrery.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: truss cropped at the right edge with empty cream above and below; by shot-20s the heatmap resolves the piece into a settled, readable end state.

pairwise_justification: No median archive exists yet, so tonight wins by default against an empty comparison set.

critique.change: Centre the truss and fit the full span inside the frame at shot-02s (it is cropped at the right edge), so the first two seconds are composed before the marker moves.
Make the memorable moment readable at shot-08s: thicken the one diagonal that flips at midspan and mark its joint with a cream dot, so the bar pulled then pushed is singled out.
Replace the blotchy glow halos on active diagonals at shot-02s with a crisp stroke and an even soft fill, so the bars stay clean at full size.
